remarks: THIS IS THE MOVE-UP HOME YOU'VE BEEN WAITING FOR. Built in 2021, this beautifully maintained 5-bedroom, 5-bath home offers approximately 4,023 square feet of living space and the room, flexibility and amenities today's lifestyle demands. Set on an impressive 12,382-square-foot lot, the floor plan includes a spacious great room, club room, den and multiple indoor/outdoor living spaces—providing room for everyone without sacrificing places to gather. The upgraded kitchen showcases GE Monogram appliances, a 48-inch built-in refrigerator, double ovens, stacked cabinetry and abundant storage. Open the stacking doors and let everyday living flow outside to your own private retreat. Pool day
